system.description:
You bob, swerve, dip, and dive to avoid incoming shots and other attacks.

Prerequisites: Droid, Hovering or Flying Locomotion, Dexterity 13, Dodge

Effect: You can reduce your Speed by up to 2 squares to increase your Dodge bonus by 1 for each square of speed you give up, until the start of your next turn. You must move at least 2 squares to gain this benefit.

Special: To use this Feat you must be equipped with and using Hovering or Flying Locomotion.

prerequisite.text: Droid, (Hovering or Flying), Dexterity 13, and Dodge feat
